metadata.method: Authority-led event identity/date/location only, original entries preserved with explicit source dependencies.

reviews.headline: Cyclone Winston strikes Fiji on February 20, 2016
reviews.location: Fiji: Koro Island and northern Viti Levu
reviews.evidence_independence: WHO disaster chronology and NASA satellite rainfall retrieval; wind analyses reuse operational cyclone datasets
reviews.corroborated_core_fact: WHO places Cyclone Winston's destructive passage across Fiji on February 20–21, 2016; NASA's GPM satellite sampled the cyclone over Fiji on February 20 at 0941 UTC.
reviews.unverified_claims: Winston's Category 5 intensity is based on regional cyclone analysis, not a surface wind instrument at each affected island. GPM instantaneous rainfall rate must not be labeled storm-total rainfall.
reviews.graphic_concept: Original Fiji track with GPM microwave rainfall cross section

reviews.headline: Cyclone Idai makes landfall near Beira after midnight local time
reviews.evidence_independence: WMO meteorological report plus IOM impact chronology, relying partly on shared storm timing
reviews.corroborated_core_fact: WMO dates Idai's Mozambique landfall to 23:30 UTC March 14, 2019, equivalent to 01:30 local time March 15 in Mozambique. IOM records the same night-of-March-14–15 crossing.
reviews.unverified_claims: The anniversary is March15 LOCAL, not March15 UTC. Early post-disaster casualty/area estimates are not finalized impact totals; estimated surge height is not a tide-gauge reading.
reviews.graphic_concept: Two-clock original track: GMT March 14 and Mozambique March 15

reviews.headline: Severe Cyclone Debbie crosses Australia's Whitsunday coast
reviews.evidence_independence: National meteorological report and state emergency response chronology share some original cyclone data
reviews.corroborated_core_fact: BoM documents severe Tropical Cyclone Debbie's Category 4 Australian-scale landfall near Airlie Beach around 12:40 p.m. AEST on March 28, 2017.
reviews.unverified_claims: Australian Category 4 is not the Saffir–Simpson category. Hamilton Island gusts were point observations. Debbie's later Queensland flooding occurred on different days.
reviews.graphic_concept: Original Whitsunday eye-crossing and observed station wind/tide timeline

reviews.headline: The 1991 Bangladesh cyclone approaches its overnight coastal landfall
reviews.location: Chittagong coast and offshore islands, Bangladesh
reviews.evidence_independence: Bangladesh disaster register and contemporary parliamentary testimony; shared original reports likely
reviews.corroborated_core_fact: Bangladesh's disaster history identifies the devastating cyclone with April 29, 1991; a contemporary UK parliamentary report says the cyclone struck the coast overnight April 29–30.
reviews.unverified_claims: Do not force an overnight Apr29–30 landfall into a precise Apr29-only instant. Historic wind, surge and fatality estimates differ significantly. A WMO/UN PDF preview was not visually verified.
reviews.graphic_concept: Original Bay of Bengal track with nighttime Apr29–30 uncertainty band

reviews.headline: Ahr Valley floodwaters crest downstream in western Germany
reviews.evidence_independence: Academic hydrologic study and ECMWF meteorology; underlying regional gauge data overlap
reviews.corroborated_core_fact: Peer-reviewed Ahr hydrology places downstream flood peaks in the early hours of July 15, 2021 after extreme rainfall July 14. ECMWF documents the meteorological event spanning July 14–15.
reviews.unverified_claims: Many upstream peaks and heavy rainfall occurred July14. Some gauges failed, so reconstructed streamflow is not direct instrument observation. Verify UTC/local times before plotting.
reviews.graphic_concept: Original July14–15 rainfall and downstream hydrograph with reconstructions dashed

reviews.headline: Krakatau's 1883 blast sends a pressure wave around the world
reviews.location: Krakatau, Sunda Strait, Indonesia; global barograph network
reviews.evidence_independence: Royal Society 1883 observation archive and USGS historical reconstruction using overlapping early documents
reviews.corroborated_core_fact: The cataclysmic Krakatau explosions culminated August 27, 1883. Royal Society archives document the resulting long-range atmospheric pressure disturbances and unusual skies.
reviews.unverified_claims: The eruptive sequence began Aug26 and precursor activity months earlier. Distant barographs registered pulses on later dates. Volcanogenic tsunami is not meteorological storm surge. Archive reproduction rights unreviewed.
reviews.graphic_concept: Original global barograph wave-arrival chronology, not a copied archive image

reviews.headline: The Great Hurricane of 1780 devastates Barbados
reviews.evidence_independence: NOAA historical synthesis and separate educational historical report share eighteenth-century documentary accounts
reviews.corroborated_core_fact: NOAA historical research places the Great Hurricane on Barbados from October 9, with its most violent effects on October 10, 1780.
reviews.unverified_claims: Historical 1780 intensity and casualty totals are reconstructions, not verified instrument measurements; a commonly cited 200-mph estimate is speculative. Distinguish other October 1780 hurricanes.
reviews.graphic_concept: Original documentary uncertainty-aware eastern Caribbean track map

reviews.headline: The 1913 White Hurricane devastates shipping on Lake Huron
reviews.location: Lake Huron and Great Lakes, United States / Canada
reviews.evidence_independence: NOAA reanalysis and Coast Guard marine history share historical reports; reconstruction is not a direct 1913 weather measurement
reviews.corroborated_core_fact: NOAA documents the November 7–10, 1913 Great Lakes storm and a particularly destructive six-hour Lake Huron interval the evening of November 9; U.S. Coast Guard documents historic marine impacts.
reviews.unverified_claims: The NOAA article's 80-mph gusts and 36-foot waves are from a retrospective MODEL simulation, not 1913 instruments. Ship-loss times and casualty tallies were retrospectively estimated.
reviews.graphic_concept: Original Lake Huron shipwreck site map with distinctly labeled simulated marine conditions

reviews.headline: Harvey brings catastrophic flash flooding to southeast Texas
reviews.evidence_independence: NCEI/NHC same NOAA institutional record; NASA satellite retrieval is additional but not independent ground flood verification
reviews.corroborated_core_fact: On August 27, 2017, NHC described flash flood emergencies across southeast Texas and NASA observed heavy-rain signatures; NCEI Griffing is an individual local report.
reviews.unverified_claims: Harvey's initial hurricane landfall was Aug25, NOT Aug27. Regional rainfall and casualties must not be deduced from one Griffing segment.
reviews.graphic_concept: Original Aug27 satellite precipitation plus dated NHC warning context

reviews.headline: Category 4 Hurricane Laura makes landfall near Cameron, Louisiana
reviews.evidence_independence: Contemporaneous NHC landfall advisory and separate federal impact report; DOE does not independently measure storm intensity
reviews.corroborated_core_fact: At 1 a.m. CDT Aug27 2020, NHC identified Category 4 Laura making landfall near Cameron; DOE reported storm-response impacts.
reviews.unverified_claims: NHC cyclone intensity is a storm assessment, not a coastal ground-station maximum wind measurement. Confirm finalized impact scope.
reviews.graphic_concept: Original warning/landfall timeline with individually sourced utility impacts
